# Sporting Chance Project

> The Sporting Chance Project is an Alternative Learning Provider supporting young people aged 5–19 with education, mentoring, life skills, and vocational pathways when mainstream schooling is a challenge.

Sporting Chance delivers mentoring, construction workshops, and alternative learning provision across schools, SEN settings, and related environments. Use the links below for accurate, up-to-date site content.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.sportingchanceproject.co.uk/): Overview of the project and how to get in touch
- [About](https://www.sportingchanceproject.co.uk/about/): Mission, history, and who we support
- [Services](https://www.sportingchanceproject.co.uk/services/): Summary of mentoring, construction, and ALP offers
- [Mentoring & Life Skills](https://www.sportingchanceproject.co.uk/mentoring-life-skills/): Mentoring and life-skills pathway details
- [Construction Workshops](https://www.sportingchanceproject.co.uk/construction-workshops/): Hands-on construction and vocational workshops
- [Alternative Learning Provision](https://www.sportingchanceproject.co.uk/alternative-learning-provision/): ALP offer for young people outside mainstream education
- [Testimonials](https://www.sportingchanceproject.co.uk/testimonials/): Feedback from young people, families, and partners
- [Case Studies](https://www.sportingchanceproject.co.uk/case-studies/): Longer-form outcome stories
- [Contact](https://www.sportingchanceproject.co.uk/contact/): Referral and enquiry form
- [Policies](https://www.sportingchanceproject.co.uk/policies/): Safeguarding and organisational policies
